I conduct research on human behavior - everything from study habits, stereotypes, emotional intelligence, and psychometrics.

Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone project, [Gender Differences or Schmifferences: Testing Replication](capstone.html), uses open-source software to analyze open-source data to replicate findings of gender differences in personality and experiencing depression, anxiety, and stress.

I care about \[topics you actually care about — e.g. housing, health equity,
sports analytics\], reproducible workflows, and explaining a model to the person
who has to trust it.
